mapper.select: select a.address_id, a.ip_address, a.status, a.community_name, a.internal_ip_address, a.target_type, a.target_name, a.manufacturer, a.access_unit, a.mapping_address, a.mapping_port, a.mapping_description, a.owner_name, a.owner_phone, a.remark, n.network_name, n.police_station_name from ipam_address a left join ipam_network n on n.network_id = a.network_id where a.status in ('ALLOCATED', 'ISSUED') and trim(a.community_name) = #{communityName} order by a.ip_value
